newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends easier on import demand.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends easier on import demand.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed easier at 42.5495/5500 to the dollar in interbank trading against the previous 42.5470/5495, dealers said.
The local unit was quoted at 42.5490/5500 in early trade and remained weaker throughout the session.
"The market was hectic. There was demand for dollars from importers. Buyers had to turn to the central bank," said one dealer with a foreign bank.
The interbank call money rates finished unchanged at 4.5 percent to 5.5 percent, dealers said.
